svg.text: Airtel and LinkedIn Premium: the dated trail
Vendor pages and dated reports, as read on 16 October 2026

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Airtel announces a free year of Adobe Express Premium for its customers

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Adobe posts its FAQ: 3 free months of Premium Career for Creative Cloud and Express Premium

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Adobe says it is investigating whether users who came through Airtel are eligible

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: News sites report an Airtel Insider perk: 3 months of LinkedIn Premium Career

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: End of the claim window one deal site gives for that perk

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: A Reddit comment says the perk was removed from Airtel's rewards page

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Airtel Insider lists Super Duolingo and PocketFM Premium, and no LinkedIn perk
LinkedIn's Airtel page: code holders are "currently not eligible to redeem"
airtel.in/insider and LinkedIn Help, checked from India
